## ✍️ Coursework

For all readings, username is biol311 and password is marinebio!!

For lecture, please read [Edwards and Lichtman](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/readings/open_ocean/MCEC_16_phytoplankton_edwards_litchman_book_chapter.pdf). While not required, I would also heavily suggest [@iversenCarbonExportOcean2023](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/readings/open_ocean/iverson-annurev-marine-032122-035153.pdf).

For paper discussion, read [@dejongeChangesUpperoceanEcosystems2024](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/readings/open_ocean/de%20Jonge%20et%20al.%20-%202024%20-%20Changes%20to%20upper-ocean%20ecosystems%20may%20directly%20impact%20abyssal%20scavenger%20communities.pdf) and then fill out your weekly [reading Q&A](/assignments/reading_q_and_a.docx)
